text:
Japan's real, PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose roughly 9–10x from 1950 to 2016, an increase of about 800–900%. The team note's figures ($8,000 in 1950, $40,000 in 2016) imply only 5x, and its 1950 starting value looks too high; Maddison-style estimates put 1950 nearer $4,000 and 2016 nearer $38,000–39,000 (2011 international dollars), though I'm recalling these rather than checking a live dataset.

CONFIDENCE: 60
